title: Rename and move a text file
description: Move the file 'hello.txt' from Desktop to a new folder named 'Archive' and rename it to 'archive_hello.txt'.
natural_language_instruction: Open File Explorer, go to the Desktop, and create a new folder named 'Archive'. Move the file 'hello.txt' into the 'Archive' folder, then rename it to 'archive_hello.txt'.
